Fucosidase treatment of porcine colonic mucin O-glycans

glyhub_GPST000643_O_S5.Rd

LC-MS profiles of porcine colonic mucin oligosaccharides exposed to individual Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron fucosidases. This experiment compares the effects of GH95 and GH29 enzymes on a complex O-glycan substrate containing different fucosylated epitopes. Supplementary Table S5 provides 108 features and 22 observations.

Usage

glyhub_GPST000643_O_S5

Format

A glyexp::GlycomicSE with 108 features and 22 observations. The abundance assay is in percentage of source total glycan AUC.

Source

GlycoPOST GPST000643. Supplementary Table S5 (media-6.xlsx). Study: https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.03.26.714468. Repository: https://glycopost.glycosmos.org/entry/GPST000643.

Details

The conditions are a no-enzyme control and BT1777, BT3155, BT3173, BT1842, BT3665, BT1625, BT4136, BT3798, BT3956 and BT4713. Each condition has columns labelled Replicate 1 and Replicate 2; these labels alone do not identify biological versus technical replicates.

The source supplies glycan AUCs, retention times and percentages normalized to total glycan AUC per observation. The abundance assay uses the percentages. Fucose, sulfation and blood-group annotations are retained as source annotations, including their zero-valued categorical flags. Features include substrate glycans and enzymatic products; O-derived denotes their experimental origin.

All 108 source composition labels are retained as typed compositions. Forty-seven source putative structures have explicit encodings; remaining structural descriptions are preserved as text without completing unspecified linkages.

See also

glyhub_data_conventions for missing-value handling, annotations and access to original measurements and source coordinates.
